mechanism: A shard previously dispatched every due timer before FIFO work. A timer that immediately rearms could postpone a queued ListenerHandshakeActor close indefinitely, including stop waiting for terminal. New ordinary turns alternate due timers and FIFO jobs; persistent services retain their alternating turns and round-robin selection.
regression_design: One blocked shard publishes one real actor close, one already-due timer and optionally one persistent service. Finite eight-turn chains drain on failure. The actor must be terminal at the second timer checkpoint. Idle and admission-pending actors, each with/without services, make four unique regressions. No network, sleeps or measured-latency pass criterion; a two-second CV guard only bounds the harness. Actual actor stop/result/inbox closure are checked.
preserved_contracts: Timer deadline/equal-deadline insertion order and FIFO order within each class; service reservation/retirement; clock-wake metadata. No preemption or absolute wall-clock guarantee for a callback that does not return. No new queues, threads, per-dispatch allocation or capacity changes. C ABI, wire, crypto and all protocol/qualification deadlines unchanged.
native_causal_limit: The former GCC Og isolated key case returned normally with a freshness failure after the fix. This is consistent with removing close starvation, but does not prove that every prior native close stall had this cause or qualify GCC DATA/KM under instrumentation.
binary_source_binding: Clean committed rebuilds and binary/cache/log identities recorded manually; no embedded/enforced source binding. BL-6 remains open.
